bodySequence.splitRule: insert one length-1 boundary embed; never create or delete Y.Text
bodySequence.joinRule: delete exactly one boundary embed; never create or delete Y.Text
bodySequence.absoluteIndexRule: UTF-16 code unit and embed each count as 1
bodySequence.paragraphLocalRule: count UTF-16 text units after opening boundary before next boundary; embeds excluded

relativeEndpointEnvelope.base64UrlRule: unpadded canonical base64url; charset ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$; length % 4 !== 1; re-encode(decoded) === original
relativeEndpointEnvelope.rejection: wrong document/envelope/schema/backend/story-sequence/checkpoint/malformed/non-resolvable rejects entire transaction with no side effects
relativeEndpointEnvelope.dormantFormatting: unresolvable explicit formatting endpoint makes range record dormant; no rewrite
relativeEndpointEnvelope.detachAnnotation: deletion collapse to consumed boundary or null detached; wrong binding rejects never detaches

removeRecord.targetAddContributionIdsRule: sorted unique non-empty; max 256; each causally observed at insert; rejects whole transaction on missing/unobserved/wrong-kind/duplicate/empty/over-limit

markContributions.projectionRule: resolve envelopes; order pair; clip at boundaries; half-open; no embed coverage; independent mark kinds

formattingEvidence.arrayOrdering: sorted by canonical UTF-8 byte order; deduplicated
formattingEvidence.resolvedSegmentsRule: half-open; ordered; non-overlapping per item; clipped at paragraph boundaries
formattingEvidence.authoredIntentFingerprintRule: canonical authored fixture omission/raw lexical intent; not persisted storage

repairEvidence.insertRule: absent-key monotonic insert; identical canonical bytes idempotent; different bytes at existing key rejects atomically

boundaryCollision.survivorRule: lowest lexicographic (actorId, commitId, creationId) retains proposed ID; losers receive deterministic derived IDs; never delete/move/rewrite boundary
